title: RawItem
description: One entry exactly as received from a source feed, normalised. Intake output; never edited by later stages.

id.description: Stable id derived from the canonical URL.

feed_url.description: Feed URL for rss; 'parallel-search:<search_id>' for search results.

url.description: Link as published by the source.

canonical_url.description: Link with tracking parameters, fragment and trailing slash removed.

summary.description: Plain-text summary from the feed (HTML stripped). May be empty.

published_at.description: Publication time in UTC (ISO 8601, Z). Null when the feed gave no usable date.

published_at_raw.description: Date string exactly as the feed wrote it.

flags.description: no_date: feed gave no date. future_date: date more than 1h ahead of fetch time. stale: older than the source's max_age_hours. date_only: source gave a day without a time; published_at stays null and the day is in published_at_raw.

duplicate_of.description: Set when this entry is the same article (same canonical URL, or same title from the same source) as an earlier item.

same_title_as.description: Items from OTHER sources with a near-identical title. A hint that outlets copy one origin: NOT independent confirmation.

origin.description: How the item reached us. Missing = rss (older records).

query.description: Search query that surfaced the item (origin=search).
